props.name: src
props.description: Image URL — a data: or blob: URL, or any same-origin or CORS-enabled address.

props.name: aspects
props.description: Aspect ratios to suggest crops for, written width:height.

props.name: onAccept
props.description: Called when a crop is accepted, with the rectangle as fractions of the image.

props.name: onCropsChange
props.description: Called whenever a crop moves — suggested or adjusted — with every current crop.

props.name: defaultShowMap
props.description: Show the interest map over the image at first.
